name: @agent-deck/desktop
description: Electron shell — boots the agent-deck server in-process-adjacent and hosts the web UI so it runs as a native app on macOS/Windows/Linux.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names server,web,electron --prefix-colors cyan,magenta,green "pnpm --filter @agent-deck/server dev:watch" "pnpm --filter @agent-deck/web dev" "pnpm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:4200/health http-get://127.0.0.1:5199 && cross-env AGENT_DECK_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4200 AGENT_DECK_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5199 nodemon --quiet --watch main.js --watch preload.cjs --exec "electron ."
